quantitative.text: The local price changed +60.7% over the 12 months to September 2024 (nominal, KES).

The national consumer price index changed +4.9% over the same 12 months (IMF/World Bank snapshot 20261120T000000_2439c9). A change in one food's price and the change in the general price level are different quantities.
The food component of the consumer price index changed +16.0%.
Food inflation exceeded headline inflation by +11.1 percentage points.

Price relative to headline CPI (12-month change at the event month): the price changed +60.7% against +4.9% for the headline CPI, a relative change of +53.2%. This is the price relative to the national average basket, not a change in any household's purchasing power.

Price relative to food CPI (12-month change at the event month): the price changed +60.7% against +16.0% for the food CPI, a relative change of +38.5%. This is the price relative to the national average basket, not a change in any household's purchasing power.

Domestic currency per US dollar changed +2.4% over the 12 months (more units per dollar), a -2.4% change in the dollar value of one unit of the local currency (official rate, period average).
